development_plan_slice.objective: Reach and enforce 95% scoped line coverage for frontend/app + frontend/components + frontend/lib, excluding E2E from the coverage numerator and denominator.

assumptions.assumption: Playwright E2E remains the canonical frontend user-flow verifier and is not replaced by this slice.
Jest with Next-compatible frontend setup is the canonical unit/integration and coverage runner for frontend/app, frontend/components, and frontend/lib.
Minimal extraction of pure helpers from large page components is allowed where required for deterministic testing.

local_adaptation.rule: For this project, Playwright owns frontend E2E and live-interaction verification.
For this project, Jest/Next owns frontend unit, integration, and coverage verification for the scoped frontend source.
This packet is controller-owned and does not authorize replacing Jest/Next with Vitest or another frontend coverage runner without explicit controller approval.

wave.name: audit-baseline
wave.goal: Measure current state and produce a prioritized remediation map.

wave.name: tool-stabilization
wave.goal: Introduce deterministic unit/integration testing and coverage commands.

wave.name: high-value-tests
wave.goal: Raise coverage efficiently through behavior-centric tests.

wave.name: docs-handoff
wave.goal: Leave a low-ambiguity handoff for future workers.

implementation_guidance.recommendation: Use Jest with Next-compatible setup plus @testing-library/react for unit/integration coverage work in this slice.
Keep coverage and transform configuration aligned with the existing Next.js frontend runtime instead of introducing an alternate unit runner.
Keep test helpers centralized to avoid duplicated mock setup across files.
Favor testing pure decision logic in extracted helpers over brittle assertions against deep DOM details.

acceptance_gate.must: 95% or higher scoped line coverage for frontend/app + frontend/components + frontend/lib.
Explicit exclusion rules for generated files, test files, E2E files, and snapshots.
Threshold enforcement is committed and executable.
Packet documentation is updated to reflect the final command set and scope.
